External mutation uses exact candidate and same tool defaults, timed separately from Single orchestration. Preserve failed prior Department trials; this is one comparison, not statistical superiority.

analysis.frozenGrader: Both 64/64; no universal quality winner follows.
analysis.time: Single reached its public acceptance gate in less automated time, including its separately measured external mutation. Department includes Author plan/test/lock/mutation/independent Verifier steps.
analysis.cost: Single was slightly more expensive in this one observed run despite fewer role calls; costs are flat-rate estimates, not invoices.
analysis.tests: Single needed one round to supply missing report evidence and one to repair a wrong test expectation for time going backwards. No implementation edits in its final correction, confirmed by Git diff. Its final tests were 16/16.
analysis.mutation: Single had fewer surviving/uncovered mutations in its own program. The two candidate source structures and mutant populations differ (310 vs 450), so raw counts or scores do not isolate test quality.
analysis.diagnostic: One null-envelope error-handling group affects Single factory/reserve/amend/confirm/cancel; default parameter destructuring runs before validation. Department returns INVALID in all 7 identical probes. These probes were source-informed and added after the run, kept separate from frozen grading.
analysis.acceptance: Single app reports completion.ready=true and awaiting_acceptance, not an orchestration failure. Operator did not accept/deliver because additional diagnostics found a contract error-code issue. Department remains completed from its original acceptance.

limitations: N=1 per successful current arm, no statistical superiority claim. Earlier failed Department trials are preserved and are not erased by this comparison.
Planner contracts and acceptance examples are authored separately from the same original SPEC; each received recorded human review.
Single means framework Single (Planner plus one coding/test/self-review role across three turns), not a single total model call.
Post-run edge audit uses an explicit interpretation of SPEC invalid shapes/scalars to include null outer request/options; it is not part of the locked 64-case grader.
No candidate was fixed after external grading; all failing/repair attempts retained.
Single mutation ran externally, not as an automatic product gate; app waiting time includes it.
